name: Toriko Kunoichi
source:
Without warning, a group of villains attacks the castle in search for the treasure.
Can the hero and his group of female ninjas escape from their grasp? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032533.html]DLsite english[/url]]
translation:
一群惡棍毫無預兆地襲擊了城堡，搜尋寶藏。主角和他率領的女忍者們能否逃脫他們的魔掌？

［來自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032533.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
